# SCI-RTC v0.1 scientific-owner revision directive for r0.3

Status: binding targeted direction received `2026-08-18`.

The complete supplied directive is titled **SCI-RTC v0.1 Revision Directive:
Bounded Iterative Notch-Plan Refinement**. It authorizes a targeted r0.3
revision while preserving r0.2 structure and all unrelated decisions.

## Binding scientific distinction

- A learned-then-fixed plan is immutable during one apply pass.
- Bounded iterative notch-plan refinement is a finite outer sequence of
  immutable learn--resolve--apply cycles.
- A complete cumulative successor plan may change only between cycles.
- Online adaptation changes parameters during one apply pass and remains
  outside v0.1.

Each cycle binds its learning population, evidence, prior accepted plan,
complete successor plan, immutable evaluation product, cumulative response,
scientific budgets, and stop/continuation cause. The default rule applies each
accepted cumulative plan to the original admitted input. A sequential cascade
requires separate explicit operator authority and complete intermediate
lineage.

The directive also requires intended-consequence assessment, artifact-aware
successor-line admission, owner-bounded stopping, complete-plan stability,
typed nonconvergence, cycle-complete provenance, restart reproducibility, and
appended stable IDs without production numbers.

No implementation, tests, audits, or reductions are authorized inputs. No
validation, science-qualification, or production-readiness claim is made.
